newsitem.title: UK: BFI extends brief rally, rises four points.
newsitem.headline: BFI extends brief rally, rises four points.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was raised four points as Thursday's brief rally continued, aided by some improvement in Panamxes in the Pacific and Handy-sizes, expecially Lakers, on the Continent.
But otherwise rates remained extremely weak, especially for Capers worldwide, brokers said.
BIFFEX at 1300 GMT was up to 10 points higher and turnvoer was 49 lots.
